en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large hospital complex in a historicist style with multiple connected buildings, gabled roofs, dormer windows and small towers. A garden and fenced yard stand in front, with a street and a few pedestrians in the foreground. At far right is an older chapel or church-like structure attached to the complex. The printed caption at the top in red reads "Freiberg i. S.  St. Johannis-Hospital."
